family.title: A Family Affair
family.description: Word around town is that a longtime married couple has separated. Neither has offered a reason.
family.hook: Family friends and neighbors may invent their own reactions; no player-owned family is assigned.

family.title: The Neighborhood Sale
family.description: Several households have organized a Saturday yard sale on Oak Street.
family.hook: Residents can buy, sell, gossip, or discover an interesting object.

school.title: School Board Meeting
school.description: The school board is hearing complaints about budget cuts and the condition of the gymnasium.
school.hook: Students, parents, and staff can attend.

school.title: Dance Committee
school.description: Volunteers are wanted for the winter dance. The student council insists there will be no trouble this year.
school.hook: Help plan the dance, lobby for music, or start a harmless rivalry.

crime.title: Car Reported Missing
crime.description: Police are asking for information about a blue sedan reportedly taken from a downtown parking lot.
crime.hook: Witnesses can come forward; do not assign guilt to another player's character.

crime.title: Broken Windows
crime.description: Three downtown storefront windows were smashed overnight. The damage was discovered before opening.
crime.hook: Shopkeepers, officers and teens can respond.

business.title: HELP WANTED
business.description: The diner is hiring for weekend and evening shifts.

business.title: Factory Meeting
business.description: Factory workers have been invited to a meeting about changes to the autumn shift schedule.
business.hook: Workers and their households can get involved.

supernatural.title: Unexplained Power Failure
supernatural.description: Several houses on the north side lost electricity for three minutes last night. The utility has not given an explanation.
supernatural.hook: Powered families may have theories; nobody is automatically blamed.

supernatural.title: Strange Reports at the Lake
supernatural.description: Two callers reported an unusual light above the lake. The sheriff's office found nothing out of place.
supernatural.hook: Skeptics, curious residents and supernatural characters can investigate.

community.title: Founder's Day Volunteers
community.description: Town hall needs volunteers to help prepare banners, booths and refreshments for the upcoming festival.
community.hook: Businesses, school clubs and families can participate.

community.title: Public Library Book Drive
community.description: The library is collecting used books throughout the month.
community.hook: Characters can donate, volunteer or attend the sale.

history.title: APPLE INTRODUCES MACINTOSH
history.description: Apple has unveiled its new Macintosh personal computer. The news is generating discussion about how computers might change schools and offices.

history.title: LOS ANGELES SUMMER OLYMPICS OPEN
history.description: The Summer Olympic Games are beginning in Los Angeles. Residents are gathering around televisions to follow the competition.

history.title: LOS ANGELES OLYMPICS CONCLUDE
history.description: The Los Angeles Summer Olympics conclude today after more than two weeks of competition.
